definitions.positiveCase: One known analog site scored against one target listed in its analogFor. A site listed for several targets is split equally between them, so every site counts once in each number below.
definitions.rocAuc: Share of (positive case, negative control) pairs, both scored against the same target, in which the known analog has the higher score. Ties count half. A site with no score counts as below every scored site.
definitions.rocAucScoredOnly: The same, using only pairs where both sites have a score.
definitions.knownInTop10Share: Share of known analogs whose cell is in the top 10% of all scored Earth cells for their matching target (site-weighted over their targets). Unscored cases count as not in the top 10%.
definitions.meanPercentileOfKnown: Mean, over scored positive cases, of the share of scored Earth cells that the site beats or ties. 0.5 is chance. This is the AUC of known analogs against every land cell, a harder test than the six controls.
definitions.snapping: Each site is scored at the nearest earth.json cell centre. Sites more than 60 km from any cell are unscored.

notes: earth.json has no "slope" values yet, so that key is left out of every score.
earth.json has no "roughness" values yet, so that key is left out of every score.
warnings: 10 of 81 known-analog cases have no score and count as failures in the strict AUC.
